# Purchasing Dashboard

## When to use this page

Use this screen to review its available records and supported actions.

## Typical tasks

- Follow the documented “Operator steps and checks” instructions below.
- Follow the documented “Screen references” instructions below.

> Ownership: Purchasing records commercial supplier commitments; Inventory posts physical quantities; Accounting and Payments manage AP and settlement.

## Operator steps and checks

Use **Purchasing → Overview** to prioritize supplier commitments, outstanding procurement and imminent deliveries. Select a supplier to narrow the dashboard. The spend figure includes only Purchase Orders in the system default currency; it must not be interpreted as a converted all-currency total. The spend trend requires the approval permission; without it, the open-orders-by-stage visualization uses the wider row. **Needs attention** and upcoming deliveries are work queues, not editable stock or financial balances.

**Operator checks:** Select and clear the supplier filter; verify cards and queues refresh without dropping the module context. Open a referenced PO or Purchase Need to perform the real next action. Do not approve or receive stock from a dashboard metric.
